heard: From the tribe of Dan he came, son of Ahisamash by name Appointed to work with Bezalel, to build God's dwelling, to fulfill the goal I have given skill to every craftsman So they can make what I have planned Oh, the art, son of Ahisama Of the tribe of Dana, skill, touch In growlers, designers, weavers, too Blue and purple, prince and hugh Masters of every craft and art Creating what is in God's heart
